name: Puppet Master, String Puller
oracle_text:
Whenever you attack, goad target creature an opponent controls. It can't block this turn. (Until your next turn, that creature attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than you if able.)
Whenever one or more goaded creatures deal combat damage to one of your opponents, create a Treasure token.
blocked_sentences: Whenever one or more goaded creatures deal combat damage to one of your opponents, create a Treasure token.

needs.what: a trigger/selector filter key 'goaded' matching creatures that are currently goaded (GameObject.goaded_by non-empty), usable on the batched creatures_deal_combat_damage trigger together with a defending-player-is-an-opponent constraint, so 'whenever one or more goaded creatures deal combat damage to one of your opponents' fires once per batch
needs.why_existing_wont_do: goad op exists and the engine tracks GameObject.goaded_by, but neither trigger_filter_keys nor selector_keys has any key reading goaded status; creatures_deal_combat_damage can filter by controller/types/etc. only, and the goaded creatures are controlled by opponents so no controller filter isolates them
